name: CUA
description: (deprecateed) create-universal-app(CUA) is an opinionated template for creating fullstack universal apps (Expo, Next, tRPC, Prisma, Clerk, Solito, Tamagui)

paragraphs: create-universal-app (CUA) is an opinionated template for creating full-stack universal (mobile + web codeshare) apps with built-in auth for both mobile and web using Expo (mobile), NextJS (web), tRPC, Prisma, Tamagui (UI + styling), and Clerk (mobile + web auth). A demo is live at .
Here's a 20 minute Youtube tutorial going over everything if that's more of your style!
You can also run npx create-t3-universal-app to start your project (by albbus). Add one of the following flags if you want a specific variation of CUA:
features: create-t3-turbo: expo, next, trpc, prisma, nextauth - no UI code share & no mobile auth.
t3-turbo-and-clerk: t3 turbo with auth for mobile + web - still no UI code share.
tamagui + solito starter: expo + next code share - no tRPC & no built-in auth.
Compiler: their unique way of turning your "style related code" into pure CSS faster. Most important thing here is probably the tree flattening thing they do.
Core: a small set of components they built aimed to replace View and Text that you use in React Native, with some advantages.
